headline: Steel Dynamics Earnings Ahead: What Past Reactions Say About The Stock
summary: Steel Dynamics (NASDAQ:STLD) is scheduled to report its earnings on Monday, October 19, 2026. The company has a market value of about $34.7 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $20.5 billion in revenue and $2.2 billion in operating profit, with net income of $1.6 billion.
